notes: Partition error: post-hoc centroids fitted on each method's own training corpus (v0 docks train for fixed + shipped tables; pooled stage-0 train for pooled tables; own-clip train for specialists), evaluated on each clip's held-out test frames (frame % 5 == 4). Identical treatment for every method.
Native error is in each table's own feature space and is NOT comparable across profiles with different K (micro 8-dim, full 16-dim; fixed is distance to a basis row in 2 dims, not a centroid).
Specialist tables are evaluated only on their own clip (the per-domain ceiling arm).
